related_questions.question: How to find someone who owes child support?
related_questions.snippet: One way would be to ask him. Other than that, you may be able to go the court web site(s) for any jurisdiction in which he has lived and see if he is in a case index online. Once you find the case number, you may be able to go the court and examine the file. Probably easier to just ask him.
